📌 A Birthday Bloom in Hongdae 🌱🎨 — Justin Turns 28

(This is going to be a long read, fair warning, but thank you for going through this in advance! 🥹 If you're already familiar with birthday ads and its significance to idols/artists, you can scroll down and go straight to 'How this project works' 🫰)

Maisan, we've officially started our Hongdae birthday ad project for Justin 🥹💚 

This is a public birthday ad in Seoul, Korea, placed in a high-traffic area of Hongik Univ. Station, at the concourse of the Seoul Airport Railroad (AREX) - this ad will be seen daily by commuters, travelers, and creatives moving through one of Seoul's most vibrant, youth- and art-driven districts 🎨🌿

📌 Ad sample and exact location: https://t.co/hQp7OfxrMz

This project celebrates Justin’s 28th birthday (July 7) 💚

As SB19's main visual & creative director, and a growing soloist with his own indie-folk sound, Justin represents 'PPop Rise' with so much heart and artistry. This birthday ad both celebrates him and introduces Justin, SB19, and PPop to global, art-forward communities where new listeners, creatives, and potential fans naturally gather 🌏🎶

It's a birthday tribute, and a meaningful step in sharing our sound beyond borders.

🌱 HOW THIS PROJECT WORKS

This birthday ad is funded through the Kooky app - similar to JuanCast or Idol Champ, but focused on Kpop–themed public spaces like subway ads.

📲 Download the Kooky app here (Available for Apple and Android): https://t.co/JgXAmrvNB7

Our goal is to earn 6,000,000 total credits (a combination of Kooky + Loovy) on or before June 24.

Once funded, Justin's birthday ad will run for 5 days starting on his birthday, giving it plenty of time to catch attention, foot traffic, and love 💚

🎯 WEEK 1 GOAL

To build momentum, our Week 1 goal is 80,000 CREDITS per day 🌽

💡 What is a Kooky? 

A Kooky is a vote in the Kooky app; similar to Stars / Chamsims in JuanCast or Idol Champ. Each account can use up to 5,000 Kooky per day, so using them daily and wisely makes a big difference 💚

🌽 HOW TO EARN FREE KOOKY DAILY

✅ Daily check-in 
✅ Watch ads
✅ Surveys & in-app participation
✅ Visit Justin's community on Kooky & like posts
✅ Vote in the daily ranking

⏰ Daily reset is 11:00 PM Manila time (Kooky + daily goal). An easy nightly habit 🌱

❗First, click to join Justin's Community on Kooky: https://t.co/eIsPaq8Myr 

📌 Once joined, here’s how to earn Kookys daily: https://t.co/fVqSl1bDVI 

🔅Other ways to earn free Kooky: https://t.co/6MIFFVEcBx (scroll past tip #5)

📲 HOW TO VOTE

If you haven't yet, download the Kooky app 🔗 https://t.co/JgXAmrvNB7

🔗 Funding page: https://t.co/8CwhzPguq3
Go to Funding to drop your Kooky and/or Loovy for Justin 💚 

📌 Video tutorial on how to vote: https://t.co/eimUZnvmbm

💡 ABOUT LOOVY

A Loovy is a paid voting credit in the Kooky app. 

💰 It cannot be earned for free 
👉 1 Loovy = 100 Kooky
🚀 There is no daily limit on how much Loovy you can use

If you choose to buy to spend credits, Vojing Official @VojingOffc  (Justin's voting team) is officially collecting donations to support the campaign. We encourage buying via voting teams to maximize funds as well as keep track of everyone’s efforts at the end of the campaign. 💚

📌 Kooky = earned through daily participation 
💰 Loovy = paid additional support

Both help our funding, but we must emphasize that consistent daily Kooky votes are the most accessible way for everyone to take part and keep the project moving forward 🌽💚

🫶 HOW ELSE YOU CAN HELP

📢 Share this post with fellow Mais & A'Tin on X, Threads, Facebook, Instagram, etc.
🗒️ Post your daily vote on your social media account to remind and encourage others to vote too
🌽 Join Justin's community and engage on Kooky (he currently has ~2.6k supporters there; we know mas madami pang Mais dyan🥹💚)

You don't need to spend money to help. 
Daily grinders, casual voters, first-timers, everyone counts. 
If you can, come vote with us, every bit adds to our total goal 💚✨

Let's make Justin's 28th birthday one to remember: celebrating his artistry, his growth, and how far his talent has reached across borders. 

From your fellow Mais and A'tin, with love 🌱🎨💚
